'''Kriselist''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Wornal sector/Legends|Wornal sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It sat at the [[Kriselist junction|junction]] between the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] and the [[D'Aelgoth Trade Route]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
During the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Kriselist was defended by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Nineteenth Army]]. As the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] [[Yag'Dhul theater|advanced]] from [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]] to [[Bomis Koori IV]] along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], the Nineteenth Army fought a number of battles and managed to retain control of Kriselist.<ref name="TEGtW" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[City/Legends|urban]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of Kriselist openly defied the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. As a result, the planet was [[Bombardment of Kriselist|bombarded]] by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Fleet]] and fell into ruin.<ref name="RES" /><ref name="TEA" />

The Empire moved on, deciding that what was left was not worth salvaging. However, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] supporters continued to inhabit the shattered cities of the world.<ref name="RES" />

After the Empire left Kriselist, the minor [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Utoxx Prentioch]] took control of portions of the cities and raised an army. This army, composed of little more than thugs and cutthroats, made life even more difficult for the planet's survivors.<ref name="RES" />

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Firmus Nantz]], in command of the [[New Republic First Fleet]], [[Skirmish at Kriselist|fought]] against Prentioch's army.<ref name="TEGtW" /> During the skirmish, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] deployed [[New Republic Special Forces/Legends|SpecForces]] in one of the shattered urban centers to find the warlord's hidden palace. The New Republic overcame Prentioch's army and freed Kriselist from his tyrannical and brutal rule.<ref name="RES" />
